name: Animatsuri
organizer: AMAI (Association for Manga and Anime in Israel)
blurb: Israel's largest anime and manga convention, a one-day summer event in Jerusalem covering anime, manga, gaming and Japanese pop culture.
notes: The only date on the site is the 2026 edition, a single day (Thursday 27.08.2026, 09:00-21:00) at Binyanei HaUma, Jerusalem -- already over before this research window opens (2026-10-05), and recorded as 'last' rather than guessed forward. No 2027 date is announced yet; AMAI runs this as its summer event (sister to Harucon in spring), so it is likely to resurface around next summer.
